name: math_counting

VINIT.justification: the initial state of the counting process before any elements are identified

TANCH.justification: the final sum that bounds the set and completes the operation

AFWD.justification: the mapping from n to n plus one that drives the count forward

AREV.justification: the reverse operation used to verify the count by decrementing

CLINK.justification: the composition of successive increments into a single sequence

IMSCRIB.justification: the recognition of a specific element as distinct and self-identical

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of the process based on whether an element remains to be counted

FFUSE.justification: the reunification of the counted and uncounted subsets into the original set

EVALT.justification: the affirmative branch taken when an uncounted element is found

EVALF.justification: the negative branch taken when no further elements remain

ENGAGR.justification: the state during the transition where an element is both counted and uncounted

IFIX.justification: the permanent record of a counted element that cannot be erased from the total

phase_3.void_description: the uninitialized state before the set is defined
phase_3.true_description: the successful identification of a next element
phase_3.false_description: the termination of the sequence upon reaching the set boundary
phase_3.both_description: the simultaneous presence of the element in the set and its registration in the count

steps.domain_action: initialize the counting process with an empty tally
identify the set as a distinct mathematical object
evaluate the set for the presence of an uncounted element
confirm the existence of a next element in the sequence
apply the successor function to increment the current count
record the increment as a permanent tally mark
compose the current tally with the preceding sequence
reconcile the counted element with the set structure
evaluate if the set contains further uncounted elements
confirm that no elements remain in the set
verify the count by checking the predecessor chain
finalize the reconciliation of the entire set
anchor the final cardinality as the terminal state of the system

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the Peano axioms translating set theory into arithmetic operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the mapping between set elements and natural number indices
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the tally register storing the current integer state
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the sequentiality axiom directing the order of element selection
phase_5.alfs_store: the CLINK L8 Organism catalog entry for math_counting

phase_6.cycle_cost: one unit of cognitive or computational effort per successor application
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: an unorganized finite collection of elements
phase_6.post_cycle_state: an ordered set with a defined cardinality
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the information gained in the count equals the reduction in set uncertainty
